FN-YSKE622-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 125
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 125 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama State Board of
Public Accountancy until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will
not otherwise affect state or local funding.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 125
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart

Senate Bill 125 (Act 2024-147) as enacted provides for the continuance of the Alabama State
Board of Public Accountancy until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
